faq.title: Questions businesses ask before choosing SystemMaster
faq.desc: Clear answers about ready products, custom development, deployment, ownership and support.

ready.q: Which SystemMaster products are ready to use?
ready.a: SM-Books Accounting Software, SM-HRMS + Task Management, and SM-ERP + CRM are live cloud products. Businesses can choose a ready product when the standard workflow fits their requirement.

custom.q: Can you build software according to our exact workflow?
custom.a: Yes. Custom ERP, CRM, HRMS, dashboards, portals, mobile apps, workflow automation, AI solutions and integrations can be designed around your process.

difference.q: What is the difference between a ready product and custom development?
difference.a: Ready products are already developed and can be adopted quickly at published pricing. Custom development is scoped around your unique workflow, integrations, roles and business rules.

ownership.q: Do we get source code for custom projects?
ownership.a: Source-code ownership and handover can be defined in the project scope and commercial agreement. We keep ownership terms clear before development begins.

deployment.q: Can the software be deployed on our domain or cloud account?
deployment.a: Yes, depending on the project architecture. Solutions can be planned for Vercel, AWS, Supabase, other supported cloud services, or client-controlled environments.

mobile.q: Will the system work on mobile devices?
mobile.a: Responsive web applications are designed for desktop, tablet and mobile. Dedicated mobile applications can also be developed where the use case requires them.

integration.q: Can SystemMaster integrate WhatsApp, APIs or existing tools?
integration.a: Yes. API integrations, WhatsApp Business integrations, payment gateways, Google services, workflow platforms and other supported systems can be connected based on technical feasibility.

timeline.q: How long does a custom software project take?
timeline.a: It depends on scope, modules, integrations and approval cycles. After discovery, we define milestones and an implementation plan instead of giving an unrealistic one-size-fits-all timeline.

support.q: Do you provide support after deployment?
support.a: Yes. Support, maintenance, improvements and future module development can be planned after launch according to the agreed support model.

language.q: Can the software support English and Hindi?
language.a: Yes. Multilingual interfaces can be planned for products and custom systems. This website itself supports English and Hindi.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how SystemMaster Automations may collect, use and protect information when you visit our website, contact us, request a demo or enquire about our products and custom software services.

collect.title: 1. Information we may collect
collect.body: We may collect information you voluntarily provide, such as your name, company name, phone number, email address, project requirement, product interest and messages sent through WhatsApp, email or enquiry forms.

usage.title: 2. How we use information
usage.body: Information may be used to respond to enquiries, provide product demos, discuss custom software requirements, deliver support, improve our services, prevent misuse and maintain business communication.

technical.title: 3. Technical and website data
technical.body: Our website or hosting providers may process basic technical data such as browser type, device information, IP address, pages visited and diagnostic logs for security, reliability and performance.

thirdParty.title: 4. Third-party services
thirdParty.body: Some interactions may use third-party services such as Vercel, WhatsApp, email providers, cloud platforms, analytics, payment services or automation platforms. Their own privacy terms may apply when you use those services.

sharing.title: 5. Data sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers only where reasonably necessary to operate, secure, support or deliver the requested service, or where required by law.

retention.title: 6. Data retention
retention.body: Enquiry and business communication data may be retained for a reasonable period for follow-up, support, contractual, accounting, security or legal purposes.

security.title: 7. Security
security.body: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information. However, no internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

choices.title: 8. Your choices
choices.body: You may contact us to request correction or deletion of information you previously provided, subject to legal, contractual, accounting and legitimate business retention requirements.

children.title: 9. Children's privacy
children.body: Our business products and services are intended for organizations and business users, not for children.

changes.title: 10. Policy updates
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as our website, products, services or legal requirements change. The latest version will be published on this page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern the use of the SystemMaster Automations website and general enquiries relating to our ready-to-use software products, demos, development services and business automation solutions.

website.title: 1. Website use
website.body: You may use this website for lawful business information, product evaluation and service enquiries. You must not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with operation or use content for unlawful purposes.

information.title: 2. Website information
information.body: We aim to keep website information accurate and current, but features, pricing, offers, availability and service details may change. Final commercial terms are those confirmed in an applicable quotation, order, subscription or agreement.

products.title: 3. Ready-to-use software products
products.body: Published product pricing is subject to the applicable plan, offer conditions, taxes, user limits, billing cycle and product-specific terms. Product features may evolve as the software is improved.

custom.title: 4. Custom software development
custom.body: Custom development begins only after scope, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities, commercial terms and other relevant conditions are agreed. Website examples and demo systems do not automatically form part of a custom project scope.

payment.title: 5. Payments and taxes
payment.body: Fees, payment milestones, subscription charges, taxes and refund conditions are governed by the specific quotation, invoice, order or agreement applicable to the purchase.

ip.title: 6. Intellectual property
ip.body: SystemMaster branding, website content, designs and proprietary materials remain protected. Source-code ownership and handover for custom projects are determined by the specific project agreement.

demo.title: 7. Demos and sample data
demo.body: Demo systems are provided for evaluation and may use sample or fictional data. Demo availability, functions and data may change and should not be treated as a production environment.

thirdParty.title: 8. Third-party services
thirdParty.body: Projects or products may integrate third-party APIs, cloud platforms, messaging services or payment providers. Their availability, charges, policies and technical limits are controlled by those providers.

liability.title: 9. Liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by applicable law, SystemMaster Automations is not responsible for indirect losses arising from website use, third-party outages, unauthorized misuse or decisions made solely on demo or website information.

changes.title: 10. Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions when our services, website, products or legal requirements change. Continued website use after an update is subject to the latest published version.
